**Generated by**: /qa-plan
**Scope**: 11 stories across 2 epics (E01 project-scaffold-ci ×6, E02 domain-foundation ×5)
**Engine**: Unity 6.3 LTS (6000.3.x) — ADR-001
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-01.md` (tracker: `production/sprint-status.yaml`)

> **Sprint-specific framing.** This is an infrastructure sprint, and at plan time the
> automated suites for every Logic story are **already authored** (122 NUnit Edit-Mode

> declared `Type:` field (all 11 declared; none inferred).

## Automated Tests Required

All Logic-story suites below are **authored and committed** (`43d1cca`); the owed work is
**execution**, gated on E01-004. Per-story QA Test Cases (the specs these tests were
implemented against) live in each story file — they are the authoritative case list and
are deliberately not duplicated here.

### E02-001..003 — RNG core (Logic)
**Test files**: `src/SweetCascade/Assets/Tests/EditMode/Rng/{Mix32_Tests,RngStream_Tests,RngService_Tests}.cs`
**What they test** (from `design/gdd/rng-service.md` Formulas/Edge Cases):
- GDD/ADR-004 anchors: `Mix32(0)==0`, `Combine(1007,3)==1547274724`, `Combine(42,20650)==653539216`, `Combine(500,1)==73026539`
- SplitMix32 sequences vs independently generated golden draws; same-seed determinism
- Lemire range mapping: result strictly `< range` incl. range 1 / 2³¹ / raw 0 / raw `uint.MaxValue`; avalanche tolerance band
- F1/F2 master-seed derivation; attempt_number bump changes the seed; stream isolation (draws on A never perturb B); fork determinism; session-log draw recording
**Edge cases covered**: zero seed, max-uint seed, degenerate ranges, empty/1/2-length shuffles.

### E02-004 — Golden-vector regression gate (Logic)
**Test file**: `src/SweetCascade/Assets/Tests/EditMode/Rng/RngGoldenVectorTest.cs`
- Asserts every section of the frozen `golden/rng_golden_v1.json` byte-for-byte via embedded
  constants (`GoldenVectors.cs`; no file I/O in unit tests — documented deviation, JSON stays
  the source of truth; regeneration command in header, proven byte-identical).
- Guard rule (control manifest): a drift is investigated, **never** "fixed" by editing a
  frozen value — deliberate change = `algorithm_version` v2 bump.

### E02-005 — LevelData POCO (Logic)
**Test file**: `src/SweetCascade/Assets/Tests/EditMode/Levels/LevelData_Tests.cs`
- Schema-v1 full-field typed construction; optional defaults (`cell_mask` → full rectangle,
  `pre_placed_pieces` → `[]`, `rng_seed` → `-1`); closed-enum objectives (`score_target`,
  `collect_color`) with list-order preservation; additive `display_name` (TR-ldf-004:
  round-trip / default / unknown-optional-field warning, `schema_version` stays 1);
  centralized constants (`MIN_PLAYABLE_CELLS`, roster, version set `{1}`, empty migration pipeline).

### E01-005 — Harness proof (Integration)
**Test files**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/Conventions/ConventionsExampleTests.cs`,
`Assets/Tests/PlayMode/SmokeExampleTests.cs` — both must pass under `game-ci testMode: all`;
the Play-Mode pass is the proof the Play-Mode assembly is wired correctly.

**Estimated new test authoring this sprint**: 0 (complete). **Estimated execution runs owed**: 1 green `testMode: all` CI run.

## Smoke Test Scope

Adapted: no gameplay scene or main menu exists yet — the generic launch checklist does not
apply. Critical paths for this sprint's hand-off, in order:

1. `tools/ci/domain-purity-scan.sh --self-test` green (guard is armed), then real scan green
2. Unity batch-mode compile green (all five assemblies)
3. Full Edit-Mode suite green — 122 tests + conventions example, incl. `RngGoldenVectorTest` byte-for-byte
4. Play-Mode `SmokeExampleTests` green under `testMode: all`
5. `python3 tools/ci/rng_reference.py` anchor check green (independent oracle stays in agreement)

*Items 1 and 5 are runnable today and pass (verified 2026-07-18). Items 2–4 constitute the
E01-004 activation run. Run `/smoke-check sprint` against this list before QA hand-off.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] **First green Mono CI run exists** (E01-004) — until then, Logic/Integration stories cap at In Review, per the must-pass evidence gate (this is why E02-001..005 and E01-005 are In Review, not Complete)
- [ ] Test files exist at the paths in the Test Summary (✔ verified on disk 2026-07-18)
- [ ] Manual evidence docs exist for the editor-pass stories (`production/qa/evidence/`)
- [ ] Smoke list above passes (`/smoke-check sprint`)
- [ ] No regressions: golden-vector suite byte-for-byte green; purity scan green
- [ ] Code reviewed (`/code-review`) and story flipped via `/story-done`

**Known gaps / flags**
- **C8 (founder)**: `UNITY_LICENSE` secrets — the single blocker for every execution item above.
- Story-file Status headers for E01-001/002/003/006 lagged sprint-status.yaml (`Ready` vs `in-progress`) — corrected alongside this plan.
- E01 stories cite no GDD (correct — infrastructure governed by architecture §5/§9 + ADRs; classification taken from declared Type fields).
- IL2CPP/WebGL golden-vector runs are **release-matrix** acceptance (ADR-J, deferred) — not Sprint 1 scope; declared in story E02-004.
